title: Low Usage - Daytime Practice
visual_summary: Patient sitting awake reading a book while wearing CPAP mask to acclimate.
narration_summary: Practice with your mask,during the day while reading or relaxing. it can help feel CPAP more natural at night

start_scene_0_3s.description: Introduces daytime desensitization strategy while awake.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Wearing mask while watching TV or reading for 20-30 minutes.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Builds familiarity and reduces nighttime anxiety.
